title: Do Existing Testing Tools Really Uncover Gender Bias in Text-to-Image Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity between the number of male and female images generated by text-to-image models using neutral text prompts across categories like professions, personalities, and activities. The study compares manually labeled gender distributions against the outputs of seven automated gender bias detectors to calculate Model Bias Scores and Prompt Bias Scores.
